Core Quality Pack.purpose: Baseline quality direction for premium marketplace-ready template products.

Template Layout Pack.purpose: Reusable layout archetypes for template structure and page composition.

Marketplace Preview Pack.purpose: Presentation styles for covers, preview images, section breakdowns, and overview layouts.

Brand/Niche Pack.purpose: Niche-facing visual directions that can be selected when they match the buyer and category.

selection_rules: Always start from the Core Quality Pack.
Choose Template Layout Pack styles based on template type and required structure.
Choose Marketplace Preview Pack styles for the cover and preview image system.
Choose Brand/Niche Pack styles only when the niche or buyer clearly supports them.
Avoid combining too many strong style directions in one product.
